profile_text.body:
Humane Intelligence is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2022 and based in Katy, Texas. It describes itself as dedicated to breaking down barriers to AI deployment for social good, and says it collaboratively designs and runs rigorous evaluations intended to make AI systems more accountable, responsible, and fair.

Its site describes three service lines. AI red teaming is offered as a paid service using the organization's own software, which it says it will release under an open source software license in 2026. AI contextual evaluations are described as rigorous, mixed-method, bespoke evaluations of a model or system's performance for a specified problem space, also a paid service, with knowledge graph and ontological AI problem space mapping under development in 2026. Bias bounties are collaboratively designed challenge sets bringing together researchers, impacted communities, and domain experts; the organization says its final self-hosted bias bounty closed in November 2025 and that it is working to move the program onto Zindi, a global data science challenge platform, in 2026. The site lists contact by email at info [at] humane-intelligence [dot] org or through a contact form.

No products, MCP servers, or individual lawsuits are listed for the company. A Texas legal exposure entry carries a count of 111.
